segments.text: In 1993, the Civilian Government came into power,
and the Daejeon Expo was held.
["Mother's Sea" Go So Young, the new generation celebrity]
Seo Tai Ji and Boys released the song, 'Whatever'.
And we are the X Generation.
Because being honest and straightforward are the special qualities of the X generation,
all of our thoughts were the same.
In the end, only one can survive.
Right now my family has an emergency...
Let's have a good time today!
Then according to the rules, let's first introduce ourselves.
I am Jung Rok, who during the three years of high school,
I never gave up my place as the whole school's second to last ranked student.
I still haven't told my mom that I'm doing a meeting.
If my mom finds out I'm dead.
we're in front of some fine ladies!
I will treat you all to everything today.
I just have an old issue.
My name is Kim Do Jin.
Do you want to have some fries?
And then I ran like crazy to go buy the tickets.
But the last boat had already left?
So I didn't have any other tricks.
Something happened between you and Eun Hee.
Then such a long night, you expect us to just play monopoly?
Time really seems to have flown by.
I can't believe I'm saying something like this.
but actually that day Eun Hee and I took the train to Chuncheon.
Was the name of the song "Feeling"?
I still remember that she sang that song for me.
Oh my god, a lawyer is using the fact that there isn't a witness to fabricate a lie.
I'm really sorry to you guys too, but actually when I was in the army,
Eun Hee came to visit me.
Outside the hostel the snow was falling,
What kind of joke is that?!
Do Jin oppa isn't here yet?
The number you have called is unavailable...
Since Do Jin's here now, let's sing the birthday song.
Let's make a wish and blow the candles!
So when a 40 year old man celebrates his birthday he'll still make a wish and blow candles.
I'm sorry if I said something wrong.
I just thought that it was weird.
If you're trying to crack a joke and no one laughs, then that shows that it was rude.
Is making a wish really funny?
I'll call a taxi for you.
You aren't doing this because of time.
Isn't it because I like Yoon?
Are you not going to listen?
Why are you chasing me out?
If you have something to say, say it to me.
I'll listen for Me Ah Ri.
There are people that we don't know well here.
Please take care of Me Ah Ri.
It's a real pity, but today we'll say our goodbyes here.
Where do you want to go?
Why are you pretending like you care?
It doesn't suit you at all.
Look at you, your mascara's all blurred.
I'm all right, so hurry and go in and check on oppa.
What if my brother hits him?
We quit smoking together, do you not remember?
I've broken up with Hong Se Ra ten times.
Even then the thought of smoking never crossed my mind.
How about you drink with me?
You haven't told me happy birthday yet.
I'll go ahead and wait for you in Jung Rok's bar.
In this day and age, at 10 PM, even middle schoolers aren't at home.
Yoon told me to let go of her hand, right?
Do you think he'd say let go of her leg?
Who told you to grab onto her hand so tightly?
It's because she's too much like our maternal grandma.
Im Me Ah Ri, how did I raise her.
He's the smartest and warmest out of all four of us.
He's also the one that you trust the most.
I tried my hardest to not meet with you by coming in very late.
I also knew that you would be coming back around now,
so I wanted to get out for a few hours.
Sit with me for a little.
I don't want to fight with you.
The two of us are a little unhappy with each other, aren't we?
If everything you said was true and you don't have any motives,
then I acted a little too out of hand.
I'm sorry for not being able to protect your pride.
It was you who showed me how much I like Tae San.
I contributed quite a bit then, didn't I?
I'll take it that you accept my apology then.
Don't let Tae San know about what happened between us.
I don't know that you told Tae San that I like him.
Please keep that secret for me.
If you think you feel more comfortable without me being here,
I was thinking the same thing,
but I don't have any money to return your deposit
And I've maxed out my loans.
I'll give it to you after I get my winnings.
Do you have to listen to know?
Why do you not have any intelligence?
Then why do you keep staring at them?
I'm afraid that they're going to destroy my things.
If the two of them get into a fight, which side will you take?
Because he's the only person who knows Park Min Sook's will.
If I don't drink today, then when should I?
Sorry, I'm only able to say these ill words.
Choi Yoon Pal, I believe in you.
The thing that you're worried about won't happen.
Because I'm trying my best to not let it happen.
It's been like this for a while now.
Their expressions don't look too optimistic.
Their expressions look as if they ate a chopped steak in your house.
The number you have called is unavailable...
Did she turn off her phone or did her phone run out of battery?
Although I don't know where she is,
I can probably guess who she's with.
Just the problem is that that person won't answer my calls.
Who is this benevolent person of good conscience?
Did you personally crash Lawyer Choi's birthday party?
It was a confession, all right?
I'm not like someone who's afraid to confess.
Since you've done something so great, why did you come to a place like this?
I don't want to see my brother's face.
You don't want to see your brother and you don't want to see your brother's girlfriend even more.
You've only been alive for how many years and you already have enemies surrounding you?
Why were you zoning out in front of the convenience store?
Drinking canned beer and eating seaweed.
Couldn't you tell that the convenience store's entrance was especially trivial and pure?
Lately because of the stress I gained 2 kg.
But did you have a fight with Se Ra?
No wonder everyone wants to have their own house.
I'm going to go ahead and sleep, so don't sleep and protect me.
but my beauty may alert others' attention.
Are you not going to leave with Yoon?
What he needs right now is indifference.
I'm in the sauna with Me Ah Ri right now.
And tell Lawyer Choi that at most I'm just staying in an unfamiliar place for a night.
She's in the sauna right now.
With a frequent customer of your bar.
Two girls are sleeping in the sauna?
We should go take a look, shouldn't we?
Who's coming to pick us up?
Don't mention his name in front of me for a while.
You called Kim Do Jin over?
Actually officially you're the one who called him over.
Why is it only you two?
Can it not be Rok oppa and Jin oppa?
How can it just be you two that came?
I was really feeling bad for you a while ago.
Let's first go to my house.
You know that he's been thrown out too, right?
Let's go to my residence hotel.
Is Me Ah Ri a guest?
You don't like me staying at your house either, right?
That's why we have to use this method.
Right now you go back to my house with me,
then tell your Min Sook unnie, "Unnie, can I stay over for the night?"
That way I can go back home.
My Teach had a fight with her roommate and can't go back home either.
She's not able to go home either?
Then Me Ah Ri can go to Jung Rok's and Teacher Seo can come with me.
I'm taking Me Ah Ri to the residence hotel.
I need to go to the bathroom.
I'll hand the car over to you.
Don't forget to bring in the person.
I think it's about time for us to introduce each other.
I'm a man like cappuccino, Rok.
You must come to this reunion dinner.
Did you guys make a bet on whether or not I'm divorced?
Anyway, couples must appear together for this time's reunion dinner.
Okay, the destination is the seventh floor.
So your character is a civil servant, not a president?
Although I don't know who you are, I think you have a misunderstanding.
For meeting the first time, this...
It's our first time to meet.
I was just thinking it odd that those words hadn't come out yet.
Do you not have an inkling yet as to who I am?
That's usually what comes out first,
if you want to pretend to be naive.
And how did you know that I was here?
She's not at all surprised to see your true wife.
Do you have a defense prepared?
Are you here for a party with your friends?
I didn't get to introduce myself.
Did you say that you were a civil servant?
I pay a lot in taxes.
When I was in high school she was my teacher.
How did you know that we were here?
There was no need for that!
You missed me so you were so worried about me, weren't you?
I finally forget about it and now you're bringing it up?
But then there Me Ah Ri made a big scene.
I like Yoon oppa, I must marry Yoon oppa and no one else!
Tae San and all of us were shocked.
Then Tae San said, Im Me Ah Ri!
Me Ah Ri was crying on the side.
Then Yoon slowly stood up and grabbed Tae San's hand,
He said, "let go of her hand."
I told you to report those details!
You only know to hide your mistakes.
So to cover Me Ah Ri we came here.
It's so late and you're showing up at a hotel?
I have a membership to the spa here.
I'll go say hello to the manager,
so whatever you guys want to do or eat in here, do it all.
Eat a lot of tasty things and change your mood, Me Ah Ri.
Sorry for the misunderstanding when meeting for the first time.
I believe that there will be a chance for me to right the wrong that I made today.
I've met her before, last year's Christmas Eve in Lawyer Choi's office.
I was curious about what kind of husband she was living with to want to divorce him on Christmas Eve.
I bet they're about to divorce.
But are all of your pass codes really the same?
Park Min Sook said we can order as we please, right?
No matter what kind of words
The last love of my life
The first time in my life that I met you
We loved till death do us apart
Our frequent customer either goes crazy while drunk or sings.
It's because I'm not drunk enough.
This was designed by Do Jin.
Why do you have to mention that sort of thing?
Of course I should, so Yi Soo won't drink it anymore.
After you designed it, the sales dropped.
And it's such a good tasting wine.
The sales increased after I designed it, all right?
Then I have to go to bed.
But why are you rushing me to go sleep?
After I drink this I'm going to go sleep too.
Then who am I going to drink with?
When you were drunk I lifted you, piggybacked you, and carried you here.
I said so, I said so.
You knew the floor and even the room number.
You must not have only been here once.
You just spent the night together.
She tries to be reserved but her brain can't keep up.
It'd be even better if you get drunk.
I waited many hours for this moment.
Have you already met a younger man?
I hope it's one who's younger by three or four years.
For now I've only decided that much.
This is my first time secretly liking someone and I don't have anyone to ask, so I'm asking you.
Is the third month of secretly liking someone always like this?
Why do you not like me?
If your heart is stolen then we can proceed with lightning speed, woman.
Although it's not the type that I go for.
A preference that no one can resist.
Those words sure gave me a lot of courage.
How about you forget reason and let your feelings overtake yourself?
Yeah, she's sleeping like a baby.
We're going to use that room.
What would two men do together in a hotel?
You aren't to the bed yet.
Didn't you say for me to let you down?
How can you come in here?
Then isn't he going to misunderstand that we slept together?
If you don't want to be misunderstood then how about we really sleep together.
I can't sleep on the sofa.
Carry me and then take me to Me Ah Ri's room.
I can't wake up right now and leave.
Then he'll realize that I was faking sleeping a moment ago.
I can't carry you a second time.
If we continue then what if Me Ah Ri's awakened?
Didn't you tell me to sleep on the sofa?
Are you guys using separate rooms?
Asking you to sleep on the sofa is still valid.
Didn't you say that you'd go straight to work?
I really couldn't stand having to wear the same clothes for two days.
I want to develop my hobby for cooking.
Where did you get that apron?
In this house having a flower like me is enough.
I bought it with the plates.
I just need to serve the soup.
You were talking like a newlywed bride.
Moreover a bride who's preparing breakfast for a husband that didn't come back all night.
Shall I get you some milk?
Invincible female King Kong is over there.
She said she heard it all.
He even bought a whole set of dishes!
It's because he has no outlet.
Or else it's because he's interested in me.
We should just have him hurry and date someone.
The mango coconut that you ordered is ready,
so I think it's better if you stop saying trash.
You didn't spit in it, did you?
Do I still have a chance to?
She's a mini Park Min Sook.
Did you have class early in the morning today?
But why didn't you reply to my text?
It's because my phone ran out of battery.
In the morning I was wanting a macchiato,
so if you were late then I wanted to ask you to buy me one.
But I came a bit early today.
Tae San, I'm in a room with Teacher Seo right now.
If we continue like this what if Me Ah Ri wakes up?
But she said that she wants to leave and told me to carry her.
If I carry her I'm afraid I'll be all over her.
The district office has denied the building permit for the Yang Chae Dong commercial building.
The owner of the building next door gave 10 reasons for appeal.
Including violations of the commercial building code and parking rights,
and obstruction of sunlight and the view.
What the hell are they saying?
No, but although this world is very large and there are many buildings,
the problem is that the owner of the building is him.
The owner of the building next door who brought up those allegations
is that dog baby, Park Kyung Duk.
He was the one who put forth those allegations, so the district office recommend that we speak to him in person.
We've really met a crazy dog.
We just need to be crazy like him.
If a dog bites a person then it won't be on the newspaper.
But if a person bites a dog then it will be on the newspaper.
Since he was the first to stoop so low, we don't have a reason to be proper about it.
We have to play low like him to win.
Find all the buildings in Seoul under Park Kyung Duk's name.
From a building to a dog house, find them all.
Once you have the list, bring your camera and go through all the buildings listed.
Illegal expansions, redesigns, etc, anything that we can catch as illegal, find it all.
Near Lee Soo Station is a restaurant.
They illegally used the expanded parking lot as a kitchen.
On the second floor is also an illegally built balcony.
It's a building in Soo Ak Dong.
Not only does it exceed FAR (floor area ratio), shipping containers are also
illegally stored there, plus there's an added extension of a rooftop room.
But besides these, is there anything especially despicable?
The kind where if they were fined because of it,
they'd be so angry that they would jump out of their dreams.
A commercial district at the Kye Poong Dong intersection.
The violations here are a bit despicable.
They've violated the building setback line.
Where a building is fined for extending beyond the vertical plane of the setback boundary?
Although the building itself isn't in violation of the line,
but because it has casement windows...
When they are opened, they just happen to exceed the limit by approximately 5cm.
Jerk, how many buildings do you own?
You sent in an appeal to the association.
The certificate is hard to come by, isn't it?
Why did you have to design that building?
You even naively filed a suit.
This sort of fate, if it were in a drama then we definitely could have fallen in love.
I don't think it'll be that easy for you guys.
If your goal is to have us revoke our lawsuit, then let me tell you directly.
We do not want to revoke our lawsuit.
At least an answer will arise from a lawsuit.
But if an appeal is accepted, then there's no answer.
A civil appeal is something that can't be stopped or delayed.
You, a mere laborer, dares to challenge me?
You #&@# you just have a few $#$*%#
I really want to $(*# hit you repeatedly %%$@ and then (*%@)%
I hung around a construction site with no women for four years,
which gave me a lot of fighting $%#*.
Exceeding the floor area ratio, illegal storage of shipping containers,
illegal construction of a balcony terrace and rooftop room extension.
That's why it makes us feel better about reporting you.
Then for 5 cm you'll be jailed for three years or less and fined less than 5 million.
Kye Poong Dong commercial store has a difference of exactly 5 cm.
By tomorrow if you pay the outstanding design fees and revoke your appeal,
then maybe I can upgrade a dog baby like you to the level of a client.
We should eat with you, but we're already full without eating.
I don't know if you remember me or not,
but I was the person who Se Ra introduced last time and we weren't able to meet...
He just said it was because of stress and tiredness.
Lately I've been like that indeed.
I just need to rest for two hours.
Even so you should call him.
If you're sick then how can you lie in the hospital by yourself?
I told you to not call him.
Se Ra fainted at the practice range.
She's in the emergency room right now.
Did Se Ra ask you to call me?
No, I just thought that you should know about this.
The doctor said that she should rest for about two hours.
Then pretend like I never answered this call.
Then please take care of her.
Tae San's at a construction site outside the city.
If you're in the room, then why didn't you say anything?
The day after tomorrow is Se Ra's competition day.
Send her a text of encouragement.
I also have something to tell you.
I know what you're going to say.
the two years that you weren't here,
I missed you so much I thought I was about to die.
Don't make me send you on a plane again.
Seriously, what is everyone so busy with?
We should do gatherings like this more often.
How about let's go play a round of golf?
Don't we have a resort in Thailand?
Come, what other things can the wives play?
Spending about a million is enough, isn't it?
But why isn't your husband here yet?
I saw that he was busy so I didn't tell him.
Seriously, I already told you it was a reunion for couples.
Your husband's so young, he must be really busy with both work and personal life.
He probably can't hold a conversation with these old men either.
Of course, their style is completely different.
But honey, don't you think Min Sook's aged a lot?
She doesn't look at all like she used to.
Do you think you look the same?
They don't know to stand by their wives.
I also saw that her face didn't look too well that I thought she divorced.
If I divorce then you'll be the first to know.
What kind of sign is that?
What are you doing, playing pitifully in the middle of a night all by yourself?
I thought you would be here.
A lot of people are pretending to be pitiful today.
Didn't you say you were practicing?
Didn't you say you had to work?
If I die, will you guys attend my funeral?
Really, anything can come out of your mouth.
Are you going to come or not?
Are you going to hold it in Gangnam?
Even so we should make an appearance.
How much money are you going to give me?
Then pay me some in advance.
Do you want to die or do you need money?
I can't continue living like this.
I really just want to give her some reparation money, then make a clean break and divorce.
But can you divorce with just 300,000?
You guys were planning on giving 100,000 each?
But we'll carry your coffin for you.
And I kept strongly believing that you guys were my friends.
You guys don't have luck with a wife, I don't even have luck with friends.
Get your butt over here right now.
If you're available then you'll drop by and take a look?
You guys better make more money,
from next month your rent is going to increase significantly.
Im Me Ah Ri, you're going to die too.
How did you know that I was here?
I just finished a meeting on the 3rd floor and was about to go to the Asia Hotel,
then I saw that your name was on the list outside.
You didn't answer my calls, so you were here?
Didn't I say that I was going to meet my friends?
This is the first time meeting after the wedding ceremony, isn't it?
You're even more good looking than the rumors.
You're practically a model, a model!
I already told you to not come.
Events like this are too boring for you.
I'll just sit for a bit, you're here anyway.
If I don't ask, then you just eat a bit.
She did eat, but she just ate a tiny bit.
Min Ji's mom, bring some water.
A new member has joined us so let's drink another glass.
I really didn't know that you come here too.
Seems like you still do practice.
Of course I have to practice.
There's been more negative criticisms of me lately.
Yeah, I saw the article from a few days ago too.
You never pretend to be above yourself.
If you've seen the article then you should also know that I'm not in the mood to chat with you today.
But you're the one who greeted first.
Then next time I'll pretend like I don't know you.
But I'm not as generous as Tae San.
Tae San's family is well off.
I really hate women like you who are gold diggers.
So you were worried about Tae San, I thought you were jealous of me.
Actually I'm really envious of you.
You were born into this world with everything.
Rich parents, a smart head, and on top of that not bad beauty.
At least it's not at the level where I want to buy it with money so don't think yourself too lucky.
Your outlook to life is definitely not to save.
If you haven't borrowed money from loan sharks and only the bank then that's already pretty good.
Aging is a really sad thing.
But dying without money is even sadder, and it's really scary.
In front of time, beauty never was an advantage.
You're good at giving me stress.
You gave me the prettiest clothes to wear so that I could have the prettiest score in the competition.
Since you're in the competition, might as well get first place.
Did the hospital say that you're okay?
You'll have to play for a week.
Even if it's tiring I must compete.
So that I can get the prize money and return your deposit.
You must feel relaxed this week.
You don't have to mind me and can come home whenever you want.
Do you have any more that you would like to say?
Don't be too stressed and play well.
I want to meet up over the weekend.
I can't talk on the phone right now.
Are you not going to look at me?
If it's not an emergency, can you leave?
Can I come in for a sec?
A moment ago when you went to court
a woman named Lee Mi Kyung brought this over.
She said that it's a lunch box and for you to enjoy it.
Seems like she prepared it for your birthday.
Is it one of those models?
Why will you not accept my present but will accept this?
What about the thing that I asked you about?
But why did you want this?
I can't throw it away, nor can I burn it.
So I wanted to put it back into its proper place.
Teach, do you not like my brother anymore?
I just hope that everything will return to its rightful place.
Although I don't know what happened, but I don't care about Se Ra or my brother.
But I'm on Se Ra's side.
Because for the longest time, I've always leaned towards my own side.
Taping back in a photo that was cut out,
does that equal to never having been cut out before?
It'll just make it unsteady and about to fall out.
Having the heart that you once gave out be returned, does that mean you never loved?
I think I should have told you to be a poet.
Grown ups really seem to be different.
How can you hide your feelings so well and not have it show at all?
Because the person that I like
may become unlucky because of me liking him.
Treat it as side effects of a one-sided love.
The number you have dialed is unavailable...
Tae San, Teacher Seo isn't answering my calls.
I'm not supposed to ask her why she's not answering my calls, right?
It's a little difficult to bear...
Director Im said that he's in the art gallery right now.
Se Ra has her first round of competition this week.
She'll be living near the site.
She won't be home for a week, so I plan to build the home bar.
Then Teacher Seo will be the only one home.
That's why I plan on going over and accompanying her.
Please wrap these up for me.
Does it take a long time to install a home bar?
Do you want me to help?
Do you not want me to be alone with Yi Soo?
Right now you're acting very out of character.
Why do you keep testing me?
I'm not testing you, I'm testing myself.
You want me to do it?
You just have to follow the diagram and put it together.
Half of it is ready to go, half of it needs installation.
If you do it all in one go, one night should be enough.
Why you should be the one to do it, you should know well.
I heard that Yi Soo likes me.
But I heard that you knew too.
You obviously knew from a long time ago.
Why did you not tell me?
What if I did tell you?
What if I would have been?
Having lived to the ripe old age of 40, you finally want to try being lovesick?
Being lovesick, having done that once before with Eun Hee is enough.
Is he a love line to you?
Then why are you sitting there?
And he can hear my voice.
I wanted you to do something like this.
If you don't unfreeze my credit cards, there's someone else I can go to.
This woman, she looks pretty today.
Women indeed need high heels to make them look more attractive.
We should try our best to not meet up.
